source.notes: 콩이, a convenience-store mascot, and its first fan meeting (fictional)
Korean OFL fonts, cut to the characters the reel shows

rationale.palette: A show stage in violet and pink (#3A2470 to #B04A9A), red velvet curtains #C8283C, gold bulbs and confetti #FFD15C; 콩이 in a soft green gradient from #B8EC93 to #4E9A3A with pink blush; white type with a pink glow and a violet edge.
rationale.type: Jua for everything: big titles with a soft glow, captions in white or gold pills that pop.
rationale.motion: A one-character show: the curtains part, the spotlight lands, 콩이 pops up and settles with a squash; every two beats a new face and prop with a hop; dancing on every beat with the arms in turn; light sticks sway on the beat; confetti tumbles.
rationale.sound: Bright pop at 128 BPM in E major (8 bars in 15 s, 16 in 30 s), pluck, bell and marimba over a full kit; glassy SFX: sparkles on each pose, a shimmer when the curtains open, pops for the goods.
rationale.visuals: All code: 콩이 drawn with gradients and highlights, no outlines (a character-IP finish, unlike the inked cartoon), five faces and four props, a stage with a bulb frame, a spotlight, curtains, light sticks, confetti, pedestals.
rationale.narration: Not recommended: 콩이 does not talk; it performs.
